messages: title(§aWelcome to TFMC)
subtitle(§ePlease pay attention to the screen)
subtitle(§eIf you cannot see the full text your GUI scale is too big)
subtitle(§eA summary will follow in the chat if you miss anything)
subtitle(§eTo play on the server you must first make a character)
subtitle(§eUse #32ed73/rpcharacter next§e to move on)
web_messages: title(Character Creator)
subtitle(Welcome to the TFMC Character Creator)
subtitle(Create and manage your RP character here on the website.)
subtitle(Your choices follow the same rules as in-game creation.)

messages: title(§aAge Verification)
subtitle(§eIn order to engage in certain types of RP like Romance RP)
subtitle(§eYou have to be above the age of 18 in real life)
subtitle(§eIf you lie on this question you will be)
subtitle(§cPermanently banned with no chance of appeal)
web_messages: title(Age verification)
subtitle(To take part in certain RP such as romance RP, you must be 18 or older in real life.)
subtitle(If you lie about this, you will be permanently banned with no chance of appeal.)

stages.message: subtitle(§eAre you 18+ in real life? Yes/No in chat)

messages: title(§aCharacter Creation)
subtitle(§eYou will now make a new character)
subtitle(§eConsult the lore documents if you are confused)
subtitle(§eAny choices made can be changed later in case of mistakes)
subtitle(§eYou can also edit your traits later to fit changes in RP)
subtitle(§eThe only unchangeable choices are your race and background)
subtitle(§eYou are expected to roleplay your traits)
subtitle(§eNot following your traits is FailRP)
subtitle(§eRemember to edit your traits when it makes sense)
subtitle(§eYou can always make a new character if you are unhappy)
subtitle(§eUse #32ed73/rpcharacter next§e to move on)
web_messages: title(Character creation)
subtitle(You will now make a new character. Consult the lore documents if you are confused.)
subtitle(Most choices can be changed later if you make a mistake, and you can edit traits as your RP changes.)
subtitle(Race and background cannot be changed. You are expected to roleplay your traits, ignoring them is FailRP.)
subtitle(You can always make a new character if you are unhappy.)

messages: title(§aCharacter Name)
subtitle(§eA character needs a name)
subtitle(§eIn the next stage you will type the name in chat)
subtitle(§eMake a good name - your IGN is not permitted)
subtitle(§eNo characters from other franchises/real life)
subtitle(§eUse #32ed73/rpcharacter next§e to move on)
web_messages: title(Character name)
subtitle(Every character needs a name. On the next step you will enter it.)
subtitle(Make a good name, your IGN is not allowed. No characters from other franchises or real life.)

stages.message: subtitle(§eType your character name in chat)

messages: title(§aClass)
subtitle(§eTFMC has several classes to choose from)
subtitle(§eYour class decides which weapons and skills you can use)
subtitle(§eSelect a class on the next stage)
subtitle(§eUse #32ed73/rpcharacter next§e to move on)
web_messages: title(Class)
subtitle(TFMC has several classes to choose from. Your class decides which weapons and skills you can use.)

stages.message: subtitle(§7Type your character age in chat)

messages: title(§aEvil RP)
subtitle(§eYour character has traits compatible with Evil RP)
subtitle(§eYou cannot select Evil archetypes yet)
subtitle(§eUnlock selecting an evil character after 24 hours on the server)
subtitle(§eThis is based on your account age, not this character)
subtitle(§eUse #32ed73/rpcharacter next§e to move on)
web_messages: title(Evil RP)
subtitle(Your character has traits compatible with Evil RP, but you cannot select Evil archetypes yet.)
subtitle(Unlock selecting an evil character after 24 hours on the server. This is based on your account age, not this character.)

messages: title(§aEvil RP)
subtitle(§eYour character has traits compatible with Evil RP)
subtitle(§eOn the next stage you may select up to 2 Evil archetypes)
subtitle(§eYou can select nothing and click confirm to skip)
subtitle(§eMake sure you read the Evil RP rules if you are Evil)
subtitle(§eUse #32ed73/rpcharacter next§e to move on)
web_messages: title(Evil RP)
subtitle(Your character has traits compatible with Evil RP. On the next step you may pick up to two Evil archetypes, or skip.)
subtitle(Make sure you read the Evil RP rules if you go evil.)
title(Backstory Injuries)
subtitle(Optional permanent injuries from your character's past. These cost no points and you may pick several.)
subtitle(You can skip this step if your character has no injuries.)
title(Backstory Prosthetic)
subtitle(Optional prosthetic from your character's past. Costs 1 point and you may pick at most one.)
subtitle(Arcane prosthetics require fuel to stay powered. You can skip this step.)

messages: title(§aCharacter Description)
subtitle(§eWrite a short description of your character)
subtitle(§eIt must be between 32 and 256 characters)
subtitle(§eDescribe how they look, sound, and come across)
subtitle(§eKeep it clear enough for others to roleplay with)
subtitle(§eUse #32ed73/rpcharacter next§e to move on)
web_messages: title(Character description)
subtitle(Write a short description of your character. It must be between 32 and 256 characters.)
subtitle(Describe how they look, sound, and come across. Keep it clear enough for others to roleplay with.)

stages.message: subtitle(§7Type your character description in chat)

messages: title(§aCharacter Clues)
subtitle(§eClues are how others know your character)
subtitle(§eVisual features, smells, home, habits, and so on)
subtitle(§eEvil characters need more clues)
subtitle(§eLow effort or false clues can be punished)
subtitle(§eUse #32ed73/rpcharacter next§e to move on)
web_messages: title(Character clues)
subtitle(Clues are how others know your character, visual features, smells, home, habits, and so on.)
subtitle(Evil characters need more clues. Low effort or false clues can be punished.)

races.name: Human
description: Adaptable and numerous across the provinces.
No inherent magical gift, but fewer limits.

races.name: Elf
description: Long-lived and closely tied to old woods and stars.
Often skilled with bow or subtle magic.

races.name: Dwarf
description: Sturdy folk of stone halls and deep craft.
Strong constitution and stubborn wills.

classes.name: Warrior
description: Front-line combatant. Strong melee and armor focus.

classes.name: Mage
description: Arcane caster. Fragile up close, powerful at range.

classes.name: Ranger
description: Scout and hunter. Bow, tracking, and wilderness craft.

classes.name: Rogue
description: Stealth and precision. Soft targets and locked doors.

traits.name: Scarred
description: Visible old wounds. Intimidating, hard to forget.

traits.name: Strong
description: This character has a strong physique.

traits.name: Weak
description: This character lacks physical prowess.

traits.name: Tall
description: Head and shoulders above the crowd.

traits.name: Stocky
description: Broad and solid. Hard to shove aside.

traits.name: Lithe
description: Lean and quick. Moves like a shadow.

traits.name: Sun-marked
description: Born under a bright sun omen.

traits.name: Moon-touched
description: Pale light follows you at night.

traits.name: Star-born
description: A rare star charted your birth.

traits.name: Callous
description: Hardened to others' pain. Cold choices come easy.

traits.name: Spiteful
description: Remembers slights. Pays them back.

traits.name: Greedy
description: Always wants more. Sharing hurts.

traits.name: Deceitful
description: Lies come naturally. Truth is a tool.

traits.name: Cynical
description: Expects the worst. Rarely surprised.

traits.name: Kind
description: Quick to help. Soft spot for the hurting.

traits.name: Stoic
description: Keeps feelings buried. Steady under pressure.

traits.name: Witty
description: Quick tongue. Turns tension into jokes.

traits.name: Tyrant
description: Rules through fear. Power is the point.

traits.name: Cultist
description: Serves forbidden powers. Faith before self.

traits.name: Bandit
description: Takes what others won't give. Roads are hunting grounds.

traits.name: One-Handed
description: This character only has one arm.

traits.name: One-Legged
description: This character only has one leg.

traits.name: Blind
description: This character is blind.

traits.name: Wooden Claw Arm
description: A crude wooden claw replaces this character's arm.

traits.name: Arcane Prosthetic Arm
description: An arcane prosthetic arm. Requires fuel to stay powered.

traits.name: Pegleg
description: A wooden pegleg replaces this character's leg.

lore: A sturdy blade for trail work.
Custom skins and lore come later.
